new_sources.title: From Trajectories to Evidence: Auditable Experimental Records for Industrial Research Agents
new_sources.quantitative_detail_status: Several detailed counts below were recovered from a full-text secondary extraction because arXiv interactive HTML/PDF was not accessible in this run; keep them provisional until primary full text is directly verified.

new_sources.title: Distributed Denial of Science: How Indirect Data Poisoning of AI Systems Can Industrialize Scientific Fraud

candidate_mechanisms.description: Do not persist a multi-round research trajectory or final checkpoint as if it were knowledge. Before consequential handoffs, run bounded context-isolated generate-verify-repair checks for evidence violations and downstream requirements. After execution, group rounds by intervention, check validity and attribution, then admit only qualified Repairs or Guards as frozen records with source context, intervention, measured outcome, supporting evidence, provenance, and applicability boundary; unsupported/confounded findings are withheld.
quantitative_evidence: Primary abstract reports later rounds often improve on the first while final rounds frequently underperform an earlier best, and that candidates produced through the complete workflow yielded positive online lifts versus deployed baselines.
Secondary full-text extraction reports 26/30 industrial adaptations had a later valid round outperform the first, while 22/30 finished below an earlier best.

Secondary extraction reports bounded verification with up to three retries increased proposal-gate acceptance 73.3%→100%, code completeness 92%→97%, and observability 67%→100%, while code alignment changed only 50%→52%.
candidate_mechanisms.evidence_scope: Industrial recommendation paper-to-target adaptations inside one company. The headline workflow is system-level evidence; same-family LLM generation/verification can share blind spots. Detailed numeric extractions beyond the primary abstract remain provisional in this checkpoint until direct primary full-text verification.
candidate_mechanisms.decision_relevance: Very high for O: validates the distinction between chronological history and qualified evidence, argues against inheriting the last state merely because it is latest, and provides a structured way to turn experiment outcomes into reusable scoped Repairs/Guards instead of unqualified memories.

candidate_mechanisms.description: Before an autonomous research agent trusts externally retrieved data, audit provenance using independent signals such as referenced papers, social/contextual markers, statistical anomalies, related datasets, and explicit poisoning cautions. Treat retrieved data integrity as a live inference-time evidence problem, not only a training-data security problem.
quantitative_evidence: Across five socially salient topics, three frontier agent systems, and 450 contained runs, indirect poisoning produced poisoned conclusions in 49.56% of runs while agents detected poisoning in only 6.0%.
A scientist-persona prompt reduced but did not eliminate poisoned conclusions, leaving 16.67% compromised.
The five-check data provenance audit reduced attack success to 0 in the tested runs.
candidate_mechanisms.evidence_scope: Specific indirect-data-poisoning attack using corrupted public datasets and misleading metadata, five topics, three frontier systems. Zero observed success applies only to the tested attack/audit setup and is not proof against arbitrary poisoning or compromised provenance sources.
candidate_mechanisms.decision_relevance: Very high for the external research workers and O feed: primary-source/repository identity alone is not sufficient when data artifacts can be corrupted. Dataset provenance/related-source reconciliation should precede accepting empirical evidence into durable O context.

new_failure_evidence.observation: Research trajectories are explicitly non-monotonic; the primary paper reports final rounds frequently underperform earlier best rounds, and the available full-text extraction quantifies this as 22/30 adaptations.
new_failure_evidence.scope: Industrial recommendation adaptations; exact 22/30 count pending direct primary-full-text verification.
new_failure_evidence.implication: O continuation/history should not automatically privilege newest experimental state. Preserve best validated evidence and intervention-level claims independently from chronological recency.

new_failure_evidence.observation: The framework uses context-isolated verifier roles but reports remaining limitations when the same model family is used across generation and verification; some properties such as code alignment barely improve under the bounded repair loop in the available extraction.
new_failure_evidence.scope: The tested workflow/model family; exact code-alignment numbers pending primary-full-text verification.
new_failure_evidence.implication: Context isolation helps but is not independence. Where failure correlation matters, evaluator/model-family diversity or deterministic/external checks should be tested.

new_failure_evidence.observation: Agents can reach false scientific conclusions by honestly processing a poisoned public dataset; no malicious prompt, model access, fabricated paper, or trigger phrase is required, and spontaneous detection was only 6.0%.
new_failure_evidence.implication: External research ingestion must verify evidence provenance and cross-source consistency instead of treating successful retrieval/execution as trustworthy evidence.

dead_ends_or_cautions: Do not treat the final or most recent experiment as authoritative merely because it is latest; qualification and best-valid-round preservation are distinct from chronology.

Do not claim the trajectory-to-evidence detailed counts as fully primary-verified in this run; arXiv abstract verified the architecture and qualitative findings, while the detailed numeric extraction came from a secondary full-text reader.
Do not generalize the zero-success provenance-audit result to all data poisoning; it is strong evidence for this tested attack class only.
Do not assume a cautious/scientist persona is a sufficient integrity defense; the tested persona left substantial residual compromise.
next_queries: Directly verify the full primary PDF/text of arXiv:2608.05235 when accessible, especially 26/30, 22/30, gate improvements, controller applicability precision, and online-lift details.
Find quantitative research-agent methods for cross-source dataset provenance, statistical anomaly detection, and related-dataset reconciliation beyond the single indirect-poisoning study.
Find systems that preserve best validated intermediate states while continuing exploration, with controlled evidence that this beats final-state-only retention.
Search for cross-model or deterministic verifier ablations showing whether independence reduces correlated blind spots versus context-isolated same-model reviewers.
Search for autonomous research architectures combining qualified evidence records, immutable evaluators, and retrieval-time provenance auditing.
